reasoning: User‑controlled request parameters are concatenated directly into an HTML fragment that is returned as the HTTP response body without any escaping or validation, leading to reflected XSS.

proof_of_concept.description: Send a request to the vulnerable endpoint with a malicious query parameter that injects a script tag.
proof_of_concept.expected_effect: The response body will contain <div><script>alert('XSS')</script><div>, causing the script to execute in the victim's browser.
